offering_description.value: Owns and operates movie theatres and hotels and resorts. Sells movie admissions, food and beverage, and screen advertising to moviegoers, and rooms, dining and event space to leisure travelers, business guests and groups.

primary_products.value: food and beverage concessions; restaurant food and drinks; gift cards; merchandise

primary_services.value: movie exhibition; hotel lodging; resort and conference services; meeting and event venues

customer_segment.value: B2C: moviegoers, leisure travelers, families, wedding and event guests; B2B: corporate meeting planners, business travelers, advertisers

end_markets.value: entertainment; hospitality; tourism; meetings and events; advertising

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: movie ticket admissions; product sales: concessions and restaurant food and beverage; service fees: hotel room stays, resort packages and meeting space rentals; advertising: on-screen advertising sold to brands and local businesses
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs movie exhibition and hospitality services for guests and groups; asset operator: owns and runs theatres, hotels and resorts, takes in guest payments

geography_served.value: US regional: Midwest and parts of the South, including Wisconsin, Illinois, Minnesota, Ohio, Michigan and Florida

specialization.value: diversified: separate theatre circuit and hotels and resorts businesses serving different customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-run theatres, hotels and resorts; online: online ticketing, hotel booking and gift card sales; direct sales: group sales and corporate meeting contracts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food service, alcohol licensing, health, safety and accessibility rules for theatres and hotels

notes: Site counts, locations and segment mix may have changed; details are approximate.
